summary.text: Ashley Bartley is a Republican candidate for the Vermont State Senate in the Chittenden North District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She currently represents the Franklin-1 District in the Vermont House of Representatives, a seat she has held since January 2023, and works as a human resources professional.

paragraphs.text: Ashley Bartley was born in Vermont and lives in Fairfax.
She graduated from Champlain Valley Union High School in 2012 and earned a B.S. in political science and economics from the University of Vermont in 2017.
Her career experience includes human resources work at the Roman Catholic Diocese of Burlington and for Neville Companies.
Bartley joined the board of directors of the Franklin County home health agency and became secretary of the Fairfax Community Library board of trustees.
